intent.summary: Restart-safe auto loop: persist a run record on SIGTERM (signal route bypasses the exception record) and keep the VERIFY pin worktree live across kill/restart (dogfood 9a07a154-pin incident)

requirements.text: Restart-safe auto loop: persist a run record on SIGTERM (signal route bypasses the exception record) and keep the VER...
A SIGTERM'd detached auto run leaves a killed run record in the store (endState killed, accumulated stage outcomes) and releases the run lock before exiting
Pin legs survive a mid-suite pin death: the dead worktree re-materializes once per load at the recorded commit with treeSha re-verified; liveness telemetry brackets the suite window
A SIGTERM'd runner terminates its spawned suite children (process-group kill); stray pins and sections-tree registrations recycle at the next run start under the run lock
The section suite runs a simulated dogfood cycle: real --fg runner on a fixture store, scripted mid-VERIFY SIGTERM, restart, green-record assert

decisions.title: Finding A cure: SIGTERM handler persists a killed run record and releases the run lock; no reconciliation backfill
decisions.rationale: latestRunRecordReadsGreen reads the latest record only; exception route loop.cjs:705-713 proves in-process persistence; acceptance is SIGTERM-only so reconciliation buys nothing today

dig.command: bwrap mask experiments + store runRecords dump + loop.cjs read
dig.output_excerpt: killed run 15f78531 absent from runRecords; restarted 9a07a154 died on its OWN pin in the sections window

decisions.title: Finding B cure: bounded pin self-heal at load time + liveness telemetry + run-start stray-pin recycle
decisions.rationale: killer unidentified (3 bwrap-refuted hypotheses), fix must be killer-agnostic; treeSha re-verified per load keeps the trust chain; store record is sandbox-unreachable; same-load re-death fails closed

dig.command: bwrap masked prune/collision-add experiments + workers.cjs loadPinnedModule read
dig.output_excerpt: masked prune keeps pin metadata; collision-add suffixes; pin died once mid-suite and stayed dead (tried latch)

decisions.title: GA3: SIGTERM handler kills the process group; stranded sections-tree metadata left to the run-start stray sweep
decisions.rationale: AMENDED R2: spawnreg pid is the RUNNER's own pid (loop.cjs:1336) — kill by it is suicide; spawnRun returns the child pid, loop backfills child_pid; handler kills only live child_pid entries

dig.output_excerpt: killed run 15f78531 suite stamps continue to 04:35+, scratch survives today

decisions.title: GA4: simulated dogfood section in VERIFY (real --fg runner, scripted SIGTERM+restart) + post-ship real cycle
decisions.rationale: live cycle cannot run while this task is current (p21 double-drive); evidence gate reads the real store, simulation cannot feed it; lesson 881b50bc demands real execution over argv asserts

dig.command: p21 archived runbook + re-enable gate code path
dig.output_excerpt: the dogfood cycle runs after this task ships; latestRunRecordReadsGreen reads the real store
